{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns current sum of mass from items stored in all unit's containers, linked items and weapons.

|s1= [[loadAbs]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - (before {{GVI|arma3|2.08|size= 0.75}} the command did not support containers, ammo boxes, weapon holders, vehicle cargos)

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= Player weight: <sqf>_weight = loadAbs player;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
private _loadUniform = loadAbs uniformContainer player;
private _loadVest = loadAbs vestContainer player;
private _loadBackpack = loadAbs backpackContainer player;
hint format [
	"Player's load:\nUniform: %1\nVest:%2\nBackpack: $3\nTotal: %4",
	_loadUniform,
	_loadVest,
	_loadBackpack,
	_loadUniform + _loadVest + _loadBackpack
];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[load]] [[maxLoad]] [[loadBackpack]] [[loadUniform]] [[loadVest]] [[getMass]] [[weightRTD]] [[getContainerMaxLoad]]
}}
